notes_for_editor: Only two sources: OpenStreetMap node 357997082 (tags; version 3, last edit comment 'Add/modify communication mast. #maproulette' by hwierzbicki, changeset 162129781, which conflicts with the observation tag and suggests the tags may come from a bulk task rather than a lookout record) and an ExpertGPS download page of Mississippi towers (name only). Two WebSearch queries and the NHLR Mississippi index (65 registered lookouts; this name is not in it) found no build date, owner, staffing or condition. Do not confuse with the OpenStreetMap nodes named Buffalo Lookout Tower in Arkansas (node 359021250, 35.86 N, 93.49 W) and South Carolina (node 357101694, marked demolished). A Mapcarta snippet mixed the Mississippi and Arkansas entries; not used. Record county is null and the story names no county. Suggested checks: Mississippi Forestry Commission records, Mississippi Department of Archives and History, and recent aerial imagery to see whether a structure stands.
